tldr: Headlines across 14 outlets converge on one action: Macron pledges interceptor missiles to Ukraine following Russian strikes. Only The Independent's headline adds a second story — Putin pulling Russia's ambassador from London — alongside the missile pledge; the coalition summit, production licences, and casualty framing visible in body text leave no trace at the headline layer.

single_outlet_findings.finding: Only headline to juxtapose the interceptor pledge with Putin pulling Russia's ambassador from London, framing the missile announcement as part of a simultaneous Russian diplomatic rupture with the UK — a narrative not signalled in any other outlet's title.

bottom_line: The headline layer collapses a multi-dimensional commitment into a single transfer announcement: 8 of 9 buckets advertise only missile deliveries, erasing the coalition summit, production licences, and casualty moral framing that body text develops — with The Independent alone using its headline to run a second story about Russia severing ties with London.
